cards.card_text: Stephen quotes the book of the prophets about the tabernacle of Molech and the star of Rephan, idols they made to worship.
cards.verse_text: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you made to worship.
cards.snippet: You have taken along the tabernacle of Molech and the star of your god Rephan, the idols you…

cards.card_text: He's seated, and He's STILL on the job: He ministers in the sanctuary, the true tabernacle.
cards.verse_text: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.
cards.snippet: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.

cards.card_text: True or false: The true tabernacle where Jesus ministers was set up by man.
cards.verse_text: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.
cards.snippet: and who ministers in the sanctuary and true tabernacle set up by the Lord, not by man.

cards.card_text: Christ, the high priest, goes through a tabernacle too.
cards.verse_text: But when Christ came as high priest of the good things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of this creation.
cards.snippet: …things that have come, He went through the greater and more perfect tabernacle that is not made by hands and is not a part of…

cards.card_text: And the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
cards.verse_text: For this reason, they are before the throne of God and serve Him day and night in His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.
cards.snippet: …His temple; and the One seated on the throne will spread His tabernacle over them.

cards.card_text: It slanders His name too, and His tabernacle, those who dwell in heaven.
cards.verse_text: And the beast opened its mouth to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.
cards.snippet: …to speak blasphemies against God and to slander His name and His tabernacle—those who dwell in heaven.

cards.card_text: After this, John looks, and the temple in heaven, the tabernacle of the Testimony, is opened.
cards.verse_text: After this I looked, and the temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony—was opened in heaven.
cards.snippet: After this I looked, and the temple—the tabernacle of the Testimony—was opened in heaven.
